decisions.evidence: Overall, despite the carboxylic acid and the only moderate lipophilicity, the combination of high drug-likeness, aromatic/halogenated structure, limited flexibility, and moderate basic functionality supports the conclusion that it crosses the BBB.

Taken together, the favorable aromatic/fluorinated scaffold, good drug-likeness, and manageable flexibility outweigh the acidic functionality and only moderate lipophilicity, so the molecule is predicted to cross the BBB.
